about_the_game:
Welcome to Camp Apocalypse Blood, the premier summer destination for monster children, misunderstood slashers, and exactly one deeply out of place human nurse.

It’s the final few weeks of summer, and maybe the last week for the camp itself. For thirty long years, Camp Apocalypse Blood's waters have known peace. But no longer.

Rival camp Wonderfang is gaining ground, General Saxsquatch is getting bribes, and Sylvia, heir to the bloody throne, has been kidnapped by Werepenguins. You are not ready.

Make strategic decisions about which human campers to terrorize, manage your alliances (or grudges) with fellow slashers, and keep your (very light) ecosystem from imploding. Every choice affects relationships, war progress, and how your camp will be remembered—if it survives at all. It's emotional damage management with all kinds of horrible teeth.

Play as Elizabeth, Jonathan, Big Tommy the Slasher, Wesley/Waxley and more.... because every choice y'all make brings you closer to your fate.

Features:

  • Genre: Visual Novel

  • Surreal, choice-driven storytelling with seven story variables to control

  • Five+ endings

  • Simulate the final days of a monster camp under siege: the war effort is in your hands as you deal with an increasingly chaotic situation

  • Everyone is having some sort of identity crisis.... some more severe than others (Wesley's feminine side is staging a jailbreak - that's where this game is)

  • Decide how you terrorize human campers as well as how you further the war against Camp Wonderfang

  • Help rewrite a forgotten college play
